tools.name: search_pages
tools.description: Search public tapa.gr pages by keywords (Greek or English). Returns matching page titles, URLs, Markdown URLs and descriptions.

tools.name: get_page_markdown
tools.description: Return the Markdown version of one public tapa.gr page. Accepts a path like /about/ or a full https://tapa.gr/ URL; other sites are refused.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Return tapa.gr website packages (399€, 690€, 990€ + VAT), renewals, extras and technical support packs (80€, 300€, 400€ + VAT).

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Return tapa.gr contact details: email, phone, WhatsApp, address and the quote request form URL.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_pages, get_page_markdown, get_contact · Private data: get_contact · Public sink: get_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_pages, get_page_markdown, get_contact · Private data: get_contact · Public sink: get_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
